original: Ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου, πρόσχες μοι· ἳνα τί ἐγκατέλιπές με; μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς σωτηρίας μου οἱ λόγοι τῶν παραπτωμάτων
translation: O God, my God, attend to me; why have you forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.
literal_notes: LXX has 'attend to me' (πρόσχες μοι), absent from the Hebrew/WEB
differences_from_web: LXX has 'attend to me' (πρόσχες μοι), absent from the Hebrew/WEB
LXX 'salvation' and 'transgressions' where WEB has 'helping me' and 'groaning'
_web_text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

original: ἐπίριψον ἐπὶ Κύριον τὴν μέριμνάν σου, καὶ αὐτός σε διαθρέψει· οὐ δώσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα σάλον τῷ δικαίῳ.
translation: Cast your care upon the Lord, and he will nourish you; he will not give the righteous shaking forever.
_web_text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

original: ἀποκάλυψον πρὸς Κύριον τὴν ὁδόν σου καὶ ἔλπισον ἐπʼ αὐτόν, καὶ αὐτὸς ποιήσει·
translation: Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in him, and he will act.
_web_text: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

original: φοβηθήσονται, ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ σοὶ ἐλπιῶ.
translation: They will be afraid, but I will hope in you.
literal_notes: LXX 'they will be afraid' (3rd person plural) where WEB has 'when I am afraid'
differences_from_web: LXX 'they will be afraid' (3rd person plural) where WEB has 'when I am afraid'
_web_text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

original: ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους. καὶ ὦτα αὐτοῦ εἰς δέησιν αὐτῶν·
translation: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their supplication.
literal_notes: Sense close to WEB; Swete numbers this Ps 33:16
differences_from_web: Sense close to WEB; Swete numbers this Ps 33:16
_web_text: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

original: πιστεύσω τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὰ ἀγαθὰ Κυρίου ἐν γῇ ζώντων.
translation: I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
literal_notes: LXX 'I believe to see' where WEB has 'I am still confident'
differences_from_web: LXX 'I believe to see' where WEB has 'I am still confident'
_web_text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

original: κατενόουν εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ ἐπέβλεπον, ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπιγινώσκων με· ἀπώλετο φυγὴ ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὴν ψυχήν μοσ.
translation: I looked to the right and watched, for there was no one who recognized me; flight has perished from me, and there is no one seeking out my soul.
uncertainties: final word of the Greek text appears in the store with a damaged ending (μοσ); read as 'my soul'
differences_from_web: LXX 'no one who recognized me' where WEB has 'no one who is concerned for me'
_web_text: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
